'''Jeremy Riel''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Endor Regionals]] on 1 July 2000 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltir Ops]], according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d958">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-endor-regional-seattle-wa-july-1-2000d958/ endor-regional-seattle-wa-july-1-2000], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-endor-regional-seattle-wa-july-1-2000d958/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
